Examples:

    Expression 1: $2x+3$
    Expression 2: $3+2x$

Yes

Yes

---

YOUR TASK


Respond with only "Yes" or "No" (without quotes). Do not include a rationale.

    Expression 1: Rearranging $x^2 - x - 1= 0$ gives $x^2 = x + 1$.  So, repeatedly substituting $x+1$ for $x^2$ gives us \begin{align*}
x^3 - 2x + 1 &= x(x^2)-2x + 1\\
&=x(x+1) - 2x + 1\\
&= x^2 + x -2x + 1\\
&= x^2 - x + 1\\
&= (x+1) - x + 1\\
&=\boxed{2}
\end{align*}
    Expression 2: None
